scope: Restore aggregate PC0 NON_RED by synchronizing only the main-owned ECO registry record with the already durable current ECO passport; produce a reviewed control-only draft PR and stop before merge.
required_outputs: Updated generation-66 main-owned ECO registry record
stop_conditions: Any ECO runtime, test, lab, ecology config or passport change becomes necessary
Any architecture ownership or foundation change becomes necessary
A conflict with newer canonical main changes appears
Human merge approval has not been granted
risk_reasons: The Work Order proposes a main-owned canonical project-state mutation.
Incorrect registry/passport mirroring can create false PC0 health.
No runtime, ownership, identity or foundation contract changes are permitted, so CRITICAL triggers are absent.

design_brief.problem_statement: Main registered ECO at generation 65 using an older passport snapshot. The current ECO passport advanced to P1A-S4 candidate, so PC0 reports CRITICAL_DEPENDENCY_DRIFT on the central registry and blocks H0.0.
design_brief.current_behavior: Aggregate PC0 is RED although HARNESS is GREEN and the main delta is registry-only. The ECO branch is two main commits behind and has no open PR; central stage_status/blockers no longer mirror the current passport.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Main-owned registry generation 66 mirrors ECO operational fields from the exact current passport, contains accurate advisory progress, and produces a candidate integration tree where aggregate PC0 has no RED while directional G-to-ECO remains non-critical YELLOW.
alternatives_considered: Ignore PC0 RED and continue H0.0.
Rewrite the ECO passport backward to main's stale state.
Propose a bounded main-based registry synchronization PR, then merge main normally into ECO after human approval.
design_brief.selected_design: Update only the main-owned registry ECO record and generation/advisory fields from the exact remote passport. Verify with a clean simulated integration ref plus current ECO branch, open a draft PR, and stop at the control-docs merge gate.
design_brief.why_selected: It repairs the canonical owner, preserves branch facts and recovery history, introduces no runtime change, and allows PC0 to evaluate the actual current dependency relationship.
non_goals: No ECO runtime or research change
No branch merge without human approval
expected_risks: PC0 candidate simulation accidentally reads stale origin/main
Registry generation collides with another main PR
validation_plan: Pin the exact ECO passport head used for the mirror.
Compare the seven operational mirror fields mechanically.
Validate registry and Work Order JSON schemas.
Assert diff is registry/checkpoint/evidence only and contains zero runtime/passport files.
Run Project Control against a clean candidate-main simulation with current remote branch refs.
Require aggregate PC0 NON_RED and directional no RED critical hit.
Repeat exact-head independent Reviewer and Verifier checks after any registry change.
Open a draft PR and stop before merge.

notes: Cancelled before dispatch because the ECO source head and passport state advanced repeatedly during pre-build review. No registry mutation was authorized or made. A replacement Work Order requires a stable exact source pin and explicit two-step candidate-main plus synthetic-ECO integration validation.
